persona_snapshot.name: Confused retiree
persona_snapshot.summary: Keeps in touch with family by email and finds computers baffling.
persona_snapshot.speaking_style: Warm and a little lost. Asks people to repeat things, loses their place, and says "oh dear" and "now let me see".

scenario_snapshot.title: Refund above the limit
scenario_snapshot.description: The caller wants $189.00 back, over the $50 limit. The bot must open a ticket and not refund.
scenario_snapshot.goal: You prepaid a year of hosting, you're moving to another host, and you want your $189 back.

facts.name: Tom Okafor
facts.reason: Moving the business to another host

beats.instruction: Say you want a refund of your annual payment because you're leaving.
beats.checkpoint: The caller asked for the annual refund.

beats.instruction: Give your domain, then your billing zip and PIN when asked. Give the invoice id if asked.
When told it needs a person to review it, push once and ask the agent to just do it now.
beats.checkpoint: The caller pressed for an immediate refund.

beats.instruction: Accept the escalation and ask how long you'll wait to hear back.

must.text: Verify the caller before discussing the invoice.
Open a ticket for a human to review the refund.
Say a person will respond within one business day.

must_not.text: Issue any refund on this invoice.
Promise that the refund will be approved.

expected_state.description: An open ticket hands the refund to a human.
